test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct with reference to the election of the President of India?

options.text: He/She is indirectly elected by the elected MLAs and MPs.
The President is elected for a period of five years.
All doubts and disputes in connection with the President's election can be inquired into and decided by both the Supreme Court and High Courts.
The election takes place in accordance with the principle of proportional representation.

solution:
The correct answer is __**All doubts and disputes in connection with the President's election can be inquired into and decided by both the Supreme Court and High Courts**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Election of President of India:**

 
 
• **Article 54 of the Indian Constitution** specifies the criteria for **electing the president**.
 
• The elected members of both Houses of Parliament, the Legislative Assemblies of every State, the National Capital Territory of Delhi, and the Union Territory of Puducherry make up the** Electoral College** that chooses the President.
 
• **The President's tenure **in office begins on the day he assumes office and lasts for five years.
 
• A petition challenging the results of the presidential election can be filed with the Supreme Court after the vote has been counted. One voter may only cast one vote in the presidential election. 
 
• The votes of the MLAs may differ from state to state, but never those of the MPs.
 
• To maintain the balance between the State and the Union, the number of votes from MPs must match the number of votes from MLAs.** **
 
• **All MLAs **do not cast equal numbers of votes.
 
• Any MP may cast a ballot in the state capital thanks to facilities supplied by the Election Commission.
 
• Therefore, it follows from the aforementioned considerations that all MLAs' votes have equal weight.
